decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree builds directly on the firm's core cultured-dairy know-how, so management can read its results and refine it, even though it has not been seen on the website since 2019.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is a close extension of existing cheese production and organic milk supply, which makes it low-risk to keep despite little recent visibility.
The spicy cheese line uses established cheese know-how, so variants may be trimmed, but dropping the whole line is less likely.
The mild soft cheese extends dairy competence the firm can still assimilate and rounds out the range, so it stays.

Washed-rind soft cheese is the most technically distant from the firm's core, has no visible results since launch, and the firm has little R&D or research cooperation to improve it, so its resources are better returned to the core business.
